**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 8,536 sessions (-41.2% WoW) | 6,322 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,317 clicks (-3.4% WoW) | 239,298 impressions (+9.5% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 4,314 GA4 sessions (-41.6% WoW) all-traffic | 1,621 GSC clicks (-8.6% WoW) organic | 9,298 GSC impressions (-5.3% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 796 GA4 sessions (-27.2% WoW) all-traffic | 83 GSC clicks (-12.6% WoW) organic | 4,556 GSC impressions (-5.4% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,197 GA4 sessions (-9.4% WoW) all-traffic | 1,034 GSC clicks (+2.2% WoW) organic | 85,294 GSC impressions (+2.0% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 4,914 GA4 sessions (-42.7% WoW) all-traffic | 585 GSC clicks (+7.9% WoW) organic | 220,532 GSC impressions (+13.8% WoW)
- GA4 sessions are down sharply site-wide (-41%) while GSC organic clicks and impressions are flat-to-up -- strong AI-search-displacement signal: content is surfacing more in Google but clicks are being absorbed by AI answers before reaching the site. All-other-pages is the clearest example: impressions +13.8%, GA4 sessions -42.7%.

**New competitor activity**
- **Flagsmith** published a coordinated block of ~16 tier-1 and tier-2 blog posts this week covering **A/B testing vs multivariate testing**, **feature experimentation**, **product experimentation framework**, **A/B testing tools**, **feature toggle management**, **dogfooding experimentation**, and **best feature flags for AI companies** -- a sustained push directly into GrowthBook's core positioning. The tier-1 posts (KD 0-26) are low-competition entry points Flagsmith can rank quickly. GrowthBook has no dedicated pages on several of these topics.
- **Unleash** published **"11 Open Source Feature Flag Tools Update"** (tier 1) -- a direct challenger to GrowthBook's open-source alternatives content -- plus **"Migrate from LaunchDarkly to Unleash"** and **"How Feature Flags Act as Kill Switches to Prevent AI-Generated Code Outages"** (tier 1). The migration post targets the same LaunchDarkly-switcher audience GrowthBook's compare pages serve.
- **Amplitude Exp** shipped 7 pages, **LaunchDarkly** 3 pages (including a changelog entry for **"New Access Token Expiration"**), and **PostHog** 16 pages this week -- none in core topics.
- ⚠️ Zero pages detected from **Eppo**, **Harness**, **Kameleoon**, **Optimizely**, and **Statsig** -- likely a monitoring gap for at least some of these.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/unleash-alternatives** (published 2026-06-19): 59 clicks (-5% WoW), 12,212 impressions, pos 6.9 -- holding near the top-5 threshold; needs link equity to push through.
- **/blog/how-to-implement-feature-flags-at-scale** (published 2026-05-26): 47 clicks (flat WoW), 18,358 impressions, pos 11.7 -- impression-to-click gap persists; answer-capsule H2 is the lever.
- **/blog/how-to-reduce-deployment-risk-with-canary-releases-and-feature-flags** (published 2026-07-27): 7 clicks this week, then 0 -- steep drop; watch next week.
- Four new pages noticed this week (zero impressions, not yet indexed): **/roles/product-management** (KD 31), **/blog/blog-decouple-deployment-release-feature-flags**, **/blog/edge-aspen-dental-scaling-100-tests-a-year**, **/blog/edge-synthetic-audiences-real-ab-tests-principal**, **/events/product-led-summit-sf**, **/insights/ai-native-startups-experiment-from-day-one** -- all need internal links to get indexed.
